## Current native status care delivery, 2026-10-06

Direct request “status effects, little stuff and more? Implement further accordingly?” delivered five saved conditions and eleven optional care/work actions through actual native stats, weather, materials, kit use and status UI. **Source/native/UI/current-build delivered, implemented-unverified.** [Delivery](docs/gm/status-care-2026-10-06/DELIVERY.md), [source/build evidence](docs/gm/status-care-2026-10-06/EVIDENCE.json), [checkpoint/release](docs/gm/status-care-2026-10-06/CHECKPOINT.md) and [five later gates](docs/gm/status-care-2026-10-06/ACCEPTANCE_BACKLOG.md) own bundle `2410d9f0ff70`/285matching local source maps/37vendor entries,943commands/41controllers/eight worlds/four plans/50sources.

After elder contact, explicit local care enrollment offers exposure/lining learning, sheltered drying/fire/focus, paid consenting craftsman grip, ordinary/precise/lined real kit work and temporary-hand recovery. Warmed/grip/tired/focus alter native cold tolerance/dexterity/stamina efficiency/intuition; lining halves the existing native rain/snow accumulation. Actual drying commits existing Wet removal/rain-counter reset once, including when Wet naturally expires during rest, while cold and permanent hand marks remain. Craftsman's irritation/orders remain meaningful. All material/coin/tool/effort and refunds retain their actual owners.

One existing saved condition/native-effect/inventory/body/job/played-clock/publisher owner remains. Pure derived Hero status descriptors reach native stats and Effects tooltips without new native-effect save rows or render rewards. Same-body/base-realm care execution is scoped; conditions expire on the common played clock even while their benefits are suppressed elsewhere. Existing5–11/old jobs/absent care stay compatible; new care IDs require this updated fork. No new save domain, source/bloodline grant, native item, world or prestige. Numeric costs/modifiers and original prose remain reversible proposals, not director acceptance.

Completed/released audited integrator and unacquired blocked assay were inspected live before root01a112fe acquired only necessary care shared joins. One exclusive Luna-high content leaf and one bounded native/source review completed/released; [before inputs](docs/gm/status-care-2026-10-06/BEFORE.json) retain dirty-work ownership. Syntax/import/definition/item/condition/source-review/compiler/build/map/link checks pass. Unit/browser/gameplay/save/reload/import/failure/keyboard/regression/director gates remain deferred and unrun. Private saves/libraries, vanilla opening, one prestige/LICENSE/attribution preserved; no setup/install/commit/push/publication/automation/external messages. Broader lore packets, enemy/bleed/poison/source-specific status families and all-world parity remain scoped follow-ons.

# Engine authoring and idea coverage

## Native status care and derived effects, 2026-10-06

[Current care delivery](gm/status-care-2026-10-06/DELIVERY.md)/[evidence](gm/status-care-2026-10-06/EVIDENCE.json)/[later gates](gm/status-care-2026-10-06/ACCEPTANCE_BACKLOG.md) own five conditions/eleven commands, implemented-unverified. Explicit `status.care.begin` uses the existing simulation enrollment; absent state remains inert. `statusCareFacts` consumes actual body/alive/native clock/weather/shelter and actor-condition/knowledge/participant state; `commitStatusCareCommand` owns equipment/custody/body/sequence admission and exact job cancellation. New group `status_care` cannot bypass the host or enroll a generic routine. Old job/condition/source ownership remains.

Saved `simulation.conditions` are the sole care owner. `Hero.setSimulationEffectReader` stores a pure callback; `getSimulationEffects` projects current supported care and visible personal body/mood descriptors. Native `addActiveEffectBonus` merges these with existing native effects; the callback never reads stats, grants resources or publishes. `refreshStatusCareStats` rebuilds aggregation only when the condition/stat signature changes after durable/native publication, and force-refreshes final load. Native tooltip/count/timer use the same merged view with explicit descriptors and retain indefinite-condition display; derived rows never enter saved `active_effects`.

Warmed cold_tolerance+3, steady dexterity×1.05, tired dexterity×.92/stamina_efficiency×.9 and focused intuition×1.05 reach actual native stats/fighters. Lined uses `statusCareRainMultiplier` on existing rain/snow accumulation; it is not an invented stat or a new weather clock. Authored job stamina costs remain fixed. Care applies to its supported human body/base realm; owned timers continue on the common played clock when benefits are suppressed.

`reconcileStatusCareNative` runs at final `persistExpansion` after joined native duration decay, detecting the actual new dry-off completion rather than a predicted preflight. It removes Wet only if that actual native entry exists, stages rain_counter0 via the existing native patch and publishes the live reset only after storage. Wet is admission-only; shelter/body/local enrollment stay completion requirements. No extra native status save store, item/world/prestige or implicit source grant. Exact state/job validator, registry/UI/host/model/main imports and source-map build are delivered; all behavioral/save/director gates remain deferred.
